title: A Rivergate for the Passage
author: Mara Okafor
blurb: Ivo Marchetti, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
